methodology: Counted by watching the clip with the counting line burned in (ffmpeg drawbox), sampled as contact sheets at ~0.8s resolution, cross-referenced against the raw event log's frame numbers and track IDs to distinguish genuine crossings from tracker ID fragmentation (see results.md). Not frame-perfect — a person's foot crossing the line line between two sampled frames could be missed — hence the tolerances below rather than exact-match assertions.
notes: One taxi visibly crosses the line once (~t=11.2s); the stock ByteTrack config split this into 3 separate track IDs within 5 frames (frames 335-340), counted 3x instead of once.

This project's tuned tracker config (tracker_tuned.yaml, match_thresh 0.8->0.65) reduces that specific fragmentation from 3 events to 2 for the same crossing — improved, not eliminated. See results.md for the full before/after comparison.

Pedestrians near the street corner at the very start (t<1s) sit right at the line's height while standing — small posture shifts can register as crossings; this is a real ambiguity in ground truth, not just a model error.
